description: Fires when column 4 is empty and the opponent (who just moved) has three in a line completed at row 1 of column 4, the cell just above column 4's empty bottom, so playing column 4 hands them the win. Column-4 specific: the same trap in other columns, or higher in column 4, does not fire; once (1,4) becomes a playable must-block it turns strongly negative.
effect: Small: forcing it high moves only a few points of probability, mildly away from column 4 (about -4 points when column 4 had mass) and otherwise redistributes; zeroing it changes moves by at most ~10-14 points in one position.
notes: Rule (col4 empty and (1,4) in their_wins): dev F1 0.709 (P 0.84, R 0.62), AUROC 0.81, sim share 0.78. Minimal pairs agree (mirror does not fire; blocking or filling (0,4) kills it). Misses are mostly weak firings: partial opponent lines through (1,4) and some late lost positions with column 4 full. Tried 'all moves lose' (F1 0.51) and 'poisoned column anywhere' (F1 0.22); both worse. Synthesis did not beat dev max (best 14.07).
